crossRefs.note: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow…
Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and…
For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man…
The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no…
even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.
But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
“Now, behold, Yahweh has kept me alive, as he spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that Yahweh spoke this word…

translations.web: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
translations.bsb: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.
translations.kjv: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh
translations.asv: A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand; But it shall not come nigh thee.
